title: The Judge
description: Golden end-to-end compile test for the Becket CW dance 'The Judge'. Verifies the corrected progression model: a progression-flagged figure runs the default DI-style end-normalization (even for Becket), and the remaining figures place dancers back onto their Becket sides to land on the Becket CW single-progression oracle. Hand-traced against docs/taxonomy.md + docs/fundamentals.md 10.6.

expected.note: Final == Becket CW single-progression oracle (equality over position + role + number + couple-identity; facing excluded).

trace.note: Per-op state, role notation, c0 . . . c4. 3 hands four (chain left_diagonal contributes +1).

modelNotes: Progression at op 6 is DEFAULT DI-style end-normalization (top couple B 2s->1s face down; bottom couple E 1s->2s face up); middle couples left un-normalized.
Op 7 (swing partner) is the 'remaining figure' that normalizes the middle couples onto their Becket sides -> matches the oracle.
petronella carries progression here: our model allows any figure to carry the per-invocation progression flag (D5), despite CallersCompendium marking petronella progressionCapable:false.
